notablePrerequisites: Basic lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}{G}{G}{U}.
description:
Activate all basic lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}{G}{G}{U}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate Shigeki's channel ability by paying {4}{G}{G} and discarding it, returning Early Harvest and Auroral Procession from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Auroral Procession by paying {G}{U}, returning Shigeki to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
